dedupe_keys.name: hybrid testing of a full scale three storey soft story woodframe building nees

description: This NEES dataset reports hybrid simulation tests of a full-scale three-storey soft-story woodframe building at the Structural Engineering and Earthquake Simulation Laboratory of the University at Buffalo, with the two upper storeys tested physically and the soft ground storey modelled numerically. It was published in 2014 by Elaina Jennings, Ershad Ziaei, John van de Lindt, WeiChiang Pang, Xiaoyun Shao, Gary Mochizuki, Mikhail Gershfeld and Douglas Rammer. Slow pseudo-dynamic tests covered five retrofits designed to performance-based criteria and FEMA P-807 guidelines and one designed by conventional engineering calculation, at several seismic intensities; a performance-based retrofit was tested in real time for torsion, and an over-retrofitted model was tested to collapse. It was the first hybrid simulation with two full storeys as the physical substructure, and it validated new performance-based seismic retrofits. Coverage: one test building. Access: the DOI resolves to the NEES warehouse, which did not respond today; NEES public data are hosted on DesignSafe, but this project's path was not found. Licence: not stated in DataCite; free. Caveats: results are summarised in a final report. Simulation uses: calibrating woodframe retrofit and collapse models. Related records: the Los Angeles woodframe case study.
